patterns.note: A full-bleed video hero with minimal, centrally placed text transitions to a spacious, asymmetrical grid layout for project showcases, maintaining ample negative space.

The primary brand name uses a highly stylized, unique display serif font, creating a strong visual identity, which is contrasted with very small, understated sans-serif text for navigation and content labels.
A high-contrast palette of deep black backgrounds and white text is consistently used, allowing the vibrant and detailed product and art photography to be the dominant color elements.

The initial hero video content scrolls up and out of view, while the brand name and navigation elements smoothly transition from an overlay position to a fixed, compact header at the top of the page, with the brand name also gaining a subtitle.
Project and product showcases are presented as a sparse, gallery-like grid of high-quality, art-directed images, each accompanied by a minimal text label and a numerical index.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a full-screen video as its initial hero, which scrolls away to reveal the main content. Simultaneously, key navigation and branding elements smoothly transition from an initial overlay position to a fixed header at the top of the viewport, likely using a combination of position sticky or fixed with CSS transforms/transitions triggered by scroll events. Content sections below the hero appear to fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: The main brand name uses an oversized, elegant display font (~3x body) with small, uppercase sans-serif text for navigation and content labels, creating a strong hierarchy through contrast.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly artistic, sculptural video hero combined with a stark, almost gallery-like presentation of work, using minimal typography and a high-contrast palette, sets it apart. The seamless transition of the brand name from a hero overlay to a sticky header is also a standout feature.
